snapshot.title: Drag-and-drop ranking
snapshot.description:
Reorder features (across all projects) and tasks (within their feature) by drag-and-drop, calling MoveItem with `before_id`/`after_id` and the item's revision.

On ABORTED (revision conflict), refresh from the RevisionConflict detail and let the user retry; on FAILED_PRECONDITION (tied ranks) show the message.
